build_note: The M14 port benchmark (chosen 2026-11-19): java-string-similarity 2.0.0 (info.debatty), a Java 8 library of string distances and similarities, one Maven module (27 files, 2.8k lines: 22 library types and 4 example programs with main), with 24 JUnit 4.12 tests in 16 files (1.0k lines) and a shared test helper. Its only dependency is jcip-annotations (@Immutable, which nothing reads). It has an interface with fifteen implementations (StringDistance and its refinements), an abstract base with four subclasses (ShingleBased), a regex, maps in the public API (a shingle profile), and interfaces the tests implement in Java (a weighted Levenshtein's costs), so calls back into Java.
